cases.smt:
(declare-fun pinned_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun source_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun active () Bool)
(assert (and (not active) (not (=> active (= source_changed pinned_changed)))))

(declare-fun next_pinned_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun next_source_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun next_active () Bool)
(declare-fun pinned_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun source_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun active () Bool)
(assert (let ((a!1 (or (and (not active)
                    next_active
                    (= next_source_changed source_changed)
                    (= next_pinned_changed source_changed))
               (and active
                    (not next_active)
                    (= next_source_changed source_changed)
                    (= next_pinned_changed pinned_changed))
               (and (not active)
                    (not next_active)
                    (= next_source_changed (not source_changed))
                    (= next_pinned_changed pinned_changed)))))
  (and (=> active (= source_changed pinned_changed))
       a!1
       (not (=> next_active (= next_source_changed next_pinned_changed))))))

(declare-fun next_pinned_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun next_source_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun next_active () Bool)
(declare-fun pinned_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun source_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun active () Bool)
(assert (and (=> active (= source_changed pinned_changed))
     active
     next_active
     (= next_source_changed (not source_changed))
     (= next_pinned_changed pinned_changed)
     (not (=> next_active (= next_source_changed next_pinned_changed)))))
cases.witness:
[active = True,
 next_pinned_changed = False,
 source_changed = False,
 pinned_changed = False,
 next_active = True,
 next_source_changed = True]

cases.smt:
(declare-fun pinned_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun next_source_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun restored_source_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun source_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun active () Bool)
(assert (and active
     (not pinned_changed)
     (not source_changed)
     next_source_changed
     (= source_changed pinned_changed)
     (= restored_source_changed pinned_changed)
     (distinct next_source_changed pinned_changed)))
cases.witness:
[active = True,
 source_changed = False,
 pinned_changed = False,
 next_source_changed = True,
 restored_source_changed = False]

cases.smt:
(declare-fun pinned_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun source_changed () Bool)
(declare-fun active () Bool)
(assert (and active
     (= source_changed pinned_changed)
     (=> active (= source_changed pinned_changed))))

scope: Abstract two-source-state exclusive guard model. Empty state and modeled coordinated transitions preserve active reader source equality to its pin. Premises: every source change occurs only while no protected operation is active; all source mutators acquire the same exclusive guard before effects, pinning occurs under that guard and it stays held through every protected use. Acquiring a native reentrant lock alone does not establish the inactive-only mutation premise. SAT bypass/endpoint controls show why complete mutator participation is required. Native paired test demonstrates source-byte ABA with a harmless comment, not changed authorization semantics. Does not prove Python/SQL refinement, native object locking, DDL/event coverage, handler/library closure, roles, crashes, liveness or backend admission.
